query: INSERT INTO configs (id, user_id, device_uuid, client_uuid, version, is_deleted, last_modified, client_last_modified, sync_state, key, value) SELECT v.id, $1, v.device_uuid, $2, v.version, v.is_deleted, $3, v.client_last_modified, 'SYNCED'::text::sync_state, v.key, v.value FROM UNNEST($4::uuid[], $5::uuid[], $6::int4[], $7::bool[], $8::int8[], $9::text[], $10::text[]) AS v(id, device_uuid, version, is_deleted, client_last_modified, key, value)
